electrode_spec.name: LNMO electrode, aqueous processed (IntelLiGent batch 1, SINTEF)
electrode_spec.description: LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 (aqueous processed); high Mn/Ni disorder spinel. Electrode design of the IntelLiGent project batch 1 (SINTEF), published under the label LNMO-AQ-1. Active-material type as stated in metadata.csv: "LNMO".

processing.detail: Aqueous electrode coating (water), as stated by the public electrode label LNMO-AQ-1 and the Zenodo batch table.

notes: Design values are as published in metadata.csv for batch LNMO-AQ-1, the one batch that realizes this design. The as-built figures of each individual disc are on the 8 electrode records that cite this spec.

Active-mass loading: mean 3.6472 mg/cm2, sample standard deviation 0.3017 mg/cm2 over n = 8 discs (range 3.2844-4.0667 mg/cm2). Computed from the per-cell values metadata.csv publishes for this batch and carried on the quantity itself, not in this note.
Dry thickness: 40.0 um for every one of the 8 discs. metadata.csv states this one value per cell, so the standard deviation is 0 by construction - a repeated declaration, not a measured spread.

Nominal areal capacity: mean 0.5106 mAh/cm2, sample standard deviation 0.0422 mAh/cm2 over n = 8 discs (range 0.4598-0.5693 mAh/cm2). Computed from the per-cell values metadata.csv publishes for this batch and carried on the quantity itself, not in this note.

Coated from the LNMO study powder lot https://w3id.org/battinfo/material/y7n3-npze-ed51-94jq. The link runs through the material spec: no field on an electrode spec or an electrode record points at a material INSTANCE (gap E8).
